title: Shellshock at the Edge
subtitle: Command injection in Torrential's diagnostics console
summary: Torrential's edge diagnostics interpolate a customer hostname into a shell command. Escape the argument, capture the diagnostic secret, then remove the shell entirely.
scenario: Field engineers diagnose DNS problems from a shared web console. The hostname goes straight into a shell string. Prove code execution, retrieve the support secret, and rebuild the call so no shell is involved.
learningObjectives: Recognise command injection in a query parameter
Use shell metacharacters to run additional commands
Replace shell invocation with argument-array execution
authorizedScope: Only the Torrential training console in this session.
riskSummary: Command injection gives an attacker the service account, its environment and any mounted credentials — usually a direct path to lateral movement.
remediation: Never build shell strings from input. Use argument arrays (execFile/spawn), validate hostnames with a strict pattern, and run services with least privilege.
conclusion: You escaped the hostname argument into a shell and read the diagnostic secret, then fixed the call so metacharacters are inert.

objectives.title: Escape the hostname argument
objectives.description: Inject a command separator into the host parameter to print the service environment and submit the diagnostic secret.

hints.text: `curl -s "$CF_TARGET_URL/api/netcheck?host=localhost;env"` — encode the semicolon if your shell needs it.

objectives.title: Remove the shell
objectives.description: Apply the policy that switches the endpoint to argument-array execution. The live check confirms metacharacters no longer execute while normal lookups still resolve.

criteria: metacharacters do not leak the secret
normal hostname lookup still returns output

walkthrough.title: Confirm injection
walkthrough.body: A semicolon separates the hostname from a second command.

walkthrough.title: Read the secret
walkthrough.body: The diagnostic environment carries the support secret.

walkthrough.title: Remove the shell
walkthrough.body: Switch to execFile so arguments cannot be reinterpreted.
